runtimeArgs: go build -buildvcs=false -o /tmp/dmn ./cmd/dmn && export DMN_CONFIG=/tmp/c/config.yaml HOME=/tmp/h && /tmp/dmn config set server.tls off && /tmp/dmn config set server.listen 0.0.0.0:8080 && /tmp/dmn config set paths.downloads /tmp/dl && /tmp/dmn setup && mkdir -p /tmp/dl/Movies && ffmpeg -loglevel error -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=5:size=640x360:rate=25 -c:v libx264 /tmp/dl/Movies/test-pattern.mp4 && echo hello > /tmp/dl/notes.txt && exec /tmp/dmn serve

configurations.name: app-web
runtimeArgs: go build -buildvcs=false -o /tmp/dmn ./cmd/dmn && export DMN_CONFIG=/tmp/c/config.yaml HOME=/tmp/h && /tmp/dmn config set server.tls off && /tmp/dmn config set server.listen 0.0.0.0:8080 && /tmp/dmn config set server.cors '["http://localhost:18081"]' && /tmp/dmn config set paths.downloads /tmp/dl && /tmp/dmn setup && mkdir -p /tmp/dl/Movies /tmp/dl/Empty /tmp/dl/Music /tmp/dl/Pictures /tmp/dl/Books /tmp/dl/Downloads /tmp/dl/Backups && head -c 300000 /dev/urandom > /tmp/dl/Downloads/ubuntu.iso.part && ffmpeg -loglevel error -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=5:size=640x360:rate=25 -c:v libx264 /tmp/dl/Movies/test-pattern.mp4 && echo hello > /tmp/dl/notes.txt && cd /tmp/dl && python3 -c "import zipfile; z=zipfile.ZipFile('pack.zip','w'); z.write('notes.txt','docs/notes.txt'); z.write('Movies/test-pattern.mp4','clip.mp4'); z.close()" && (/tmp/dmn serve &) && exec python3 -m http.server 8081 --directory /web
